solver_input_allowlist: Frozen problem identifiers and human-checked formal statements

acquisition_rules: Prefer reviewed statement-only artifacts; do not download benchmark solution collections and then call their removal isolation
Bind every acquired artifact to a full source revision and content hash before packaging
Reject source ambiguity or lack of permission before scored generation
Keep retained sensitive receipts and any non-public proofs under ignored task storage; commit only permitted summaries
Do not use agent self-review as human statement fidelity or independent task verification
